I have/had 3 giant tubs of loose photos, film, negatives, etc in my storage unit and knew the photos were getting destroyed. So I purchased these and several other sizes along with some 3 ring binders to preserve the photos. Perhaps 50 years from now my daughter will get a kick out of the ancient practice of taking photos with a real camera and film.

Awesome tripod for travel. I have an older Mafroto that I wouldn't trust with a cheap peice of glass let along my L series lenses. I also have a larger, newer Vangaurd, which is a beast of a tripod. It's amazing but it would take up way too much room to travel with. This tripod fits the bill for travel and I feel comfortable enough with it to support the heavyset of my gear. It also looks pretty cool.

I hadn't used my old projector for so long that the lens rusted into the body and would no longer focus. Recently, I've been searching through some old slides and needed a new projector to be able to view my slides without squinting at the inch by inch and a half pictures. This projector is a nice one. I especially like that it has a remote control, which my old one didn't have. Also, the zoom lens that came with it is nice. It lets me adjust the size of the image I'm projecting.

This is an absolute life safer! We have a neighbor that has been harassing us by standing in front of our door yelling things at us and throwing trash in front of our door. Cops wouldn't do nothing. I highly recommend everyone to get a ring device of some sort.
